content: कौतुकम् [कुतुकस्य भावः अण्] .²1 Desire, curiosity, wish. .²2 Eagerness, vehemence, impatience. .²3 Anything creating curiosity or wonder. .²4 The marriage thread (worn on the wrist); करोयमामुक्तविवाहकौतुकः <ls>Ku. 5. 66</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 1</ls>. .²5 The ceremony with the marriage thread preceding a marriage; सबाष्पा कौतुकक्रिया <ls>Pratijñā. 4. 24</ls>. .²6 Festivity, gaiety. .²7 Particularly auspicious festivity, solemn occasion (such as marriage); ‘कौतुकं मङ्गले हर्षे हस्तसूत्रे कुतूहले’ इति शाश्वतः; प्रस्थान˚ <ls>Ś. 4</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 25</ls>. .²8 Delight, joy, pleasure, happiness; निवृत्तनानारसकाव्यकौतुकम् <ls>Bh. 3. 140</ls>; ˚रसाः <ls>U. 6. 33</ls>; <ls>Māl. 10. 3</ls>; <ls>U. 3. 37</ls>. .²9 Sport, pastime. .²10 A song, dance, show or spectacle. .²11 Joke, mirth. .²12 Friendly greeting, salutation.
